work.math: 238,392 VND for 30 days is only the CPU minimum. Add disk, a floating IP, pay-as-you-go data sent out, add-ons and tax. The price for 100 GB of traffic a month is unavailable. Builds use your own tools.
There is no public price for a VM running 730 hours with 1 vCPU and 1 GiB. Add disk, a floating IP, 100 GB of traffic, add-ons and tax. The VM size's capacity and price are unverified.
658,392 VND for 30 days is only the starting price for CPU and Postgres added together. Required capacity, 10 GB of traffic, daily seven-day backups, VM, disk, network and tax are not priced.
